name: lineage
description: A cooperative family documentation and research platform: family members contribute recordings, photographs, documents and links; Lineage transcribes, indexes and tags them, researches public records beside the family's version, and builds a sourced record (genealogy, timeline, and a Familypedia of people, places, events, vessels, organizations and objects) with every fact cited and contradictions kept. Stories, a printed book (Typst, print preflight) and narration are exports of the record.
